summary: Bob asks Alice for one last job: the Meridian vault on Friday night. She reluctantly agrees.
key_events: The target is the Meridian vault
The job is on Friday night

lines.text: I need you for one more job, Alice. Just one.
lines.speaker: bob

lines.text: You said that last time, kid.
lines.speaker: alice

lines.text: The vault at the Meridian. Friday night. Trust me.
lines.speaker: bob

lines.text: Fine. But if this goes wrong, I'm done with you.
lines.speaker: alice

summary: Alone on the phone, Carol reveals she is an undercover cop who has infiltrated the crew.
key_events: Carol is an undercover police officer
Police plan a raid on Friday

lines.text: (on the phone) I'm in. They don't suspect a thing.
lines.speaker: carol

lines.text: Tell the captain the raid is on for Friday.
lines.speaker: carol

summary: Carol introduces herself to Alice as the new driver; Alice is suspicious but welcomes her.
key_events: Alice accepts Carol into the crew

lines.text: You must be Alice. I'm your driver.
lines.speaker: carol

lines.text: Welcome to the crew. Don't make me regret it.
lines.speaker: alice
